scope: Current public repository capabilities and explicitly unshipped proposals. Not a discoverable MCP tool, signed capability assertion, production API or versioned Kernel contract.

current.limits: Validates Pack definitions; does not authenticate external data or auto-enforce runtime input completeness.
Creates a local template, not a safe domain-specific production policy.
Declared fixture behavior, not external source truth or universal admission.
Read-only typed shape check with WITHHELD_NOT_RUN for incomplete/invalid input; does not invoke Kernel, prove source completion/authenticity or grant execution authority.
Requires separately admitted input; canonical receipt and bundle generated by Kernel.
Scoped integrity and optional receipt signature; no automatic trusted time, external mandate or replay.
WITHHELD and NOT RUN are external orchestration states.

contribution: optional; no Pack publishing or upstream PR required for private local use
update_policy: Must be reviewed and version-pinned against exact public source before use as a decision input. This metadata is not itself a source of authority.
